step1_analysis.description: A sub-circuit extracted from a 200-MHz receiver, likely functioning as a variable-gain IF amplifier or a mixer branch. It consists of NMOS and PMOS differential or cascode structures that process the intermediate frequency signals.

paper_reference.title: A Low-Power 200-MHz Receiver for Wireless Hearing Aid Devices

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit under nominal bias conditions.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming 1kOhm tail resistors to VDD/GND from common source nodes (N0, N16) biased at ~0.9V, the tail currents are ~0.9mA each. Total current = 1.8mA. Power = 1.8mA * 1.8V = 3.24mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adapted for SKY130 1.8V supply with standard 1kOhm biasing resistors to establish a stable operating point.

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency AC voltage gain from the input (LABEL_NET_3) to the output (N25).

sky130_expected.calculation: Id ~ 450uA per branch. Vov = sqrt(2*Id / (unCox * W/L)) = sqrt(900u / (270u * 10)) = 0.57V. gm = 2*Id/Vov = 1.57mS. With a 10kOhm load, Gain = gm * Rload = 15.7 V/V = 23.9 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS parameters (unCox=270uA/V^2) and a 10kOhm load, which perfectly aligns with the paper's reported 23 dB gain for the IF amplifier.

unity_gain_frequency.description: The frequency at which the AC voltage gain drops to 0 dB (1 V/V).

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole is formed by the 10kOhm load and parasitic capacitance (~50fF). f_pole = 1 / (2*pi*10k*50f) = 318 MHz. UGF = Gain * f_pole = 15.7 * 318MHz = ~5 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The circuit must easily pass the 200 MHz IF/RF signal. The UGF in a modern 130nm process will be well into the GHz range for this topology.

transient_vpp.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage swing for a given input signal amplitude.

sky130_expected.calculation: For a 20mVpp input signal at 10MHz, multiplied by a linear gain of 15.7 V/V, the output swing should be 20mV * 15.7 = 314mVpp.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Verifies the large-signal time-domain behavior and ensures the amplifier is not clipping for small IF signals.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, unity gain frequency, and transient output swing of the IF amplifier fragment.
step3_testbench.spice:
* IF Amplifier / Mixer Fragment Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N0 N26 N26 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N25 N26 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N16 N2 N27 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 N27 N16 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N14 LABEL_NET_3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 LABEL_NET_5 N16 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 LABEL_NET_6 N14 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N11 LABEL_NET_7 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Supplies and Biasing
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.01 10Meg)
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 DC 0.9
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 DC 0.9
VLABEL_NET_7 LABEL_NET_7 0 DC 0.9

* Bias for floating gates
VN26 N26 0 DC 0.9
VN27 N27 0 DC 0.9

* Load resistors for floating drains
RN25 N25 VDD 10k
RN3 N3 GND 10k
RN4 N4 VDD 10k
RN11 N11 GND 10k

* Tail resistors for common sources
RN0 N0 0 1k
RN16 VDD N16 1k

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_db = vdb(N25)
meas ac mid_gain find gain_db at=100k
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis for Output Swing
tran 1n 500n
meas tran vout_pp pp v(N25)

quit
.endc
.end
